audience.text: Developers building Node.js applications in TypeScript who need to programmatically read, write, and manipulate Excel workbooks and export data to text formats.

capabilities.text: Create new workbooks from scratch or load existing .xlsx files, then modify cell values, formulas, and styles.
capabilities.title: Create and edit Excel workbooks

capabilities.text: Apply font, fill, border, alignment, and number format styling to cells using Style, Font, Fill, Border, and Alignment objects.
capabilities.title: Apply comprehensive cell styling

capabilities.text: Export workbooks to HTML, CSV, JSON, and Markdown formats using Workbook methods like toHtml(), toCsv(), toJson(), and toMarkdown().
capabilities.title: Export to multiple formats

capabilities.text: Set column widths, row heights, merged cells, hidden rows, auto filters, and apply conditional formatting and data validation rules.
capabilities.title: Configure worksheet features

capabilities.text: Add, retrieve, and remove hyperlinks and comments on cells using HyperlinkCollection and CommentCollection APIs.
capabilities.title: Manage hyperlinks and comments

capabilities.text: Access worksheets, cells, shared strings, charts, images, and shapes through Workbook and Worksheet collections.
capabilities.title: Access workbook metadata and structure

limitations.text: Text export (CSV, JSON, Markdown) returns a string and does not provide direct file-writing helpers.
Text export is one-way; there is no corresponding import path to load CSV, JSON, or Markdown back into a Workbook.
The library does not support all Aspose.Cells for .NET Enterprise Edition features beyond this FOSS TypeScript edition's scope.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic Excel workbook creation and editing in TypeScript without requiring Microsoft Excel or Office automation.
Supports loading existing .xlsx files, modifying cell content and formatting, and saving changes back to disk.
Provides export to HTML, CSV, JSON, and Markdown for reporting and data interchange scenarios.
Offers a TypeScript-native API surface compatible with Aspose.Cells for consistent spreadsheet manipulation workflows.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Cells-FOSS-for-TypeScript is a free, open-source TypeScript library for creating, loading, editing, and saving Excel .xlsx workbooks without requiring Microsoft Excel.

uncertainties: The exact Node.js version requirement beyond '18 or later' is not specified in the facts.
The specific Excel features not supported by this FOSS edition compared to Aspose.Cells for .NET Enterprise Edition are not detailed.
Whether the library supports password-protected workbooks or encryption beyond Workbook.protect() is not confirmed.
The complete list of supported save formats beyond .xlsx, HTML, CSV, JSON, and Markdown is not fully detailed.

workflows.name: Create and style a new workbook
workflows.text: Create a new Workbook instance, add data to cells, apply styles, and save as .xlsx using Workbook.save().

workflows.name: Load and modify an existing workbook
workflows.text: Load an existing .xlsx file with Workbook.load(), update cell values, and save the modified workbook.

workflows.name: Export workbook to HTML
workflows.text: Load a workbook and export it to HTML using Workbook.save() with saveFormat option or Workbook.toHtml().

workflows.name: Apply conditional formatting
workflows.text: Add conditional formatting rules to cell ranges using ConditionalFormat and ConditionalFormatCollection APIs.

workflows.name: Configure data validation
workflows.text: Define data validation rules for cell ranges using DataValidation and DataValidationCollection APIs.

workflows.name: Manage worksheet layout and formatting
workflows.text: Set column widths, row heights, merge cells, hide rows, and configure auto filters via Worksheet methods.
